content.text:
I fixed all three problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` passes (5 of 5).

- **Hang after a failure:** a rejected job never freed its slot, so the queue stalled. A job that threw synchronously or returned a plain value also broke it, because the code assumed `fn()` always returned a promise. Every outcome now frees the slot and starts the next job.
- **`onIdle()` resolving early:** it only checked that nothing was pending. It now also requires that nothing is running.
- **One job at a time after `resume()`:** `next()` started at most one job per call. It now loops until all free slots are filled.

I added three regression tests to `test/queue.test.js`:

- failures (async rejection and a synchronous throw) don't stop the queue;
- `onIdle()` waits for running jobs;
- `resume()` with concurrency 4 starts 4 jobs at once.

I didn't run the new tests against the old code to confirm they fail there.
